tasks.label: 1. ⚡ [爆速開発用] WebAssembly ビルド (O0・1秒以内)
tasks.command: mkdir -p dist_web && em++ -std=c++17 -O0 src/Main.cpp -o dist_web/game.html --shell-file shell_minimal.html -s EXPORTED_FUNCTIONS='["_main","_em_on_mouse_move","_em_on_mouse_down","_em_on_mouse_up","_em_on_key_down","_em_on_key_up"]' -s EXPORTED_RUNTIME_METHODS='["ccall","cwrap"]' -s ALLOW_MEMORY_GROWTH=1 && echo '⚡ 高速ビルド完了! (dist_web/game.html)'

tasks.label: 2. 🚀 [本番用] WebAssembly 最適化ビルド (O2)
tasks.command: mkdir -p dist_web && em++ -std=c++17 -O2 src/Main.cpp -o dist_web/game.html --shell-file shell_minimal.html -s EXPORTED_FUNCTIONS='["_main","_em_on_mouse_move","_em_on_mouse_down","_em_on_mouse_up","_em_on_key_down","_em_on_key_up"]' -s EXPORTED_RUNTIME_METHODS='["ccall","cwrap"]' -s ALLOW_MEMORY_GROWTH=1 && echo '🚀 本番最適化ビルド完了!'

tasks.label: 3. 🌐 [プレビュー] Webサーバー起動 (ポート8080)
4. 🪟 [学祭展示用] Windows .exe 静的リンク出力
tasks.command: mkdir -p dist_windows && x86_64-w64-mingw32-g++ -std=c++17 -O2 -static -static-libgcc -static-libstdc++ src/Main.cpp -o dist_windows/Siv3D_Game_Windows.exe -lgdi32 -luser32 -mwindows && echo '✅ Windows exe 出力完了: dist_windows/Siv3D_Game_Windows.exe'
